evidence: src/listen/websocket.rs: WebsocketHandle has no configure method
asyncapi:listen.v1.yml:ListenV1Configure.finding: Rust cannot send the documented Listen V1 mid-stream Configure message.
asyncapi:listen.v1.yml:ListenV1Configure.test_plan: Add a localhost WebSocket test that captures the exact Configure frame and asserts a typed request builder serializes supported keyterms and features.

asyncapi:listen.v1.yml:ListenV1Configure.finding: Rust does not expose a typed confirmation when a Listen V1 Configure update is applied.
asyncapi:listen.v1.yml:ListenV1Configure.test_plan: Add a fixture-based deserialization test for ConfigureSuccess and a local WebSocket test that delivers it after Configure.

asyncapi:listen.v1.yml:ListenV1Configure.finding: Rust does not expose a typed rejection when a Listen V1 Configure update is refused.
asyncapi:listen.v1.yml:ListenV1Configure.test_plan: Add a fixture-based deserialization test for ConfigureFailure and a local WebSocket test that preserves the server code and description.
